superseded_setup: The first Rollback Base and Oracle runs used a digest from the old hashing algorithm and stopped before behavior scoring. The public digest was restored after checking the retained image; the complete corrected matrix is reported here. The initial NeMo control manifest also specified Oracle as the patch base; all34 controls were verified Base-relative and the whole corrected matrix was rerun. Its earlier control scores are invalid. Remaining independent cases were subsequently run in three-way parallel batches; interrupted attempts are excluded. Initial logs remain in the external run record.
